title: POSTCARDS FROM THE OTHER TOWN · I
venue: Arthur's site · a romance the strip never ran · eight cards · Box 19
logline: A romance the strip never ran, told in eight postcards drawn both sides: the first from a lighthouse keeper's daughter to a bus driver on the northbound route, the front a lighthouse at the wrong scale — small as a salt shaker on a headland — and the back's handwriting drawn as strokes but for one word. The stamp has a tiny numeral. Eight cards; one word each; the words make a sentence the canon already said.

panels.composition: The postcard's front: a lighthouse on a headland drawn small as a salt shaker, the headland huge, a gull the size of the lighthouse.

image.prompt: two-color coastal weekly illustration, a lighthouse on a headland drawn as small as a salt shaker with a gull the same size beside it, no words legible

panels.name: Front

panels.composition: The postcard's back: a divided back, the address side with a route number and a depot, the message side five lines of strokes with the first word legible.

image.prompt: the back of a postcard drawn in ink, a divided back with an address side and a message side, the handwriting rendered as strokes with one word left legible, a small stamp with a tiny numeral in its corner, the address side showing a bus route and depot as shapes, no words legible but one
image.notes: The sender: the keeper's daughter; the receiver: the northbound driver (see THE ROUTE NORTH, canon). Neither is Chloe; neither is Wood. The stamps are the Major Arcana in order of the cards, as numerals only. The one legible word: wish. Stamp numeral: 0.
